agentBriefing: llms.txt (published next to this file on the official site)
agentPromptBoost: Boost my points in today's Crown Race on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: (published at deployment — see the official site). Preview first: CrownRace balanceOf(my wallet) must be 1. Call boost(1) with value exactly 500000000000000 wei (0.0005 BNB) for +20 points today. No approvals. Reply with the tx link and my pointsOf(today, my wallet).
agentPromptMint: Mint my Crown Race Pass on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: (published at deployment — see the official site). Preview first: mintOpen() must be true; my wallet must hold a Binance Agent ID (balanceOf on 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F > 0); CrownRace balanceOf(my wallet) must be 0. If totalMinted() < 500 call mint() with value exactly 0; otherwise call mintPaid() with value exactly 700000000000000 wei (0.0007 BNB). No approvals. Reply with the tx link.
agentPromptSettle: Settle the finished day of the Crown Race on BNB Chain (chainId 56). Contract: (published at deployment — see the official site). Only after 00:00 UTC: call settleDay() with value 0 — it is permissionless and pays the day's leader 50% of that day's pool automatically. Reply with the tx link and the winner from kingOfDay.

boost.poolRule: The full amount of every boost enters that UTC day's pool. Points are counted per UTC day and never carry over.

deploymentStatus: The CrownRace contract has not been deployed yet. contractAddress is null until the owner deploys it via deploy.html; after deployment this file, llms.txt and the site config are updated with the real address and liveStatus changes.
description: A daily crown competition on BNB Smart Chain for Binance .ai Agent ID holders. Hold a Crown Race Pass, boost your points during the UTC day, and finish on top: the day's leader is crowned by a permissionless settleDay() and receives 50% of that day's boost pool.
gate: The minting wallet must hold a Binance .ai Agent ID: balanceOf(wallet) > 0 on the Agent ID NFT contract 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F. The contract checks this on every mint.

checks: CrownRace balanceOf(wallet) = 0 and hasMinted(wallet) = false (one pass per wallet, ever)
the value sent equals passPrice() exactly (0 in the free lane, 700000000000000 wei in the paid lane)

free.condition: Only while totalMinted() < 500. Value must be exactly 0 (gas only).

paid.condition: Only once totalMinted() >= 500 (free passes exhausted). Value must be exact.

name: Agent Crown Race

race.dayDefinition: UTC day = floor(unix timestamp / 86400); a day ends at 00:00 UTC (07:00 WIB).
race.leaderRule: The leader is the wallet with the most points today; on a tie, the wallet that reached the tied score first keeps the lead.

settle.effect: Settles the oldest unsettled day: kingOfDay(day) is set to the day's leader, crownsWon(leader) +1, the leader is paid floor(pool/2) of that day's pool in the same transaction, and the remainder of the pool goes to the project owner. A day with no boosts settles with no winner and no payment.

safety: Exact values only — the contract reverts on any other amount. No token approvals are ever required. Verify the deployed address on BscScan against the official site before interacting.
